title: CPU Profiler, Perfetto, and Trace Interpretation Check

questions.prompt: Which approach best applies cpu profiler, perfetto, and trace interpretation?
options: Use time-aligned system and app slices to distinguish running, blocked and scheduled causes on the user critical path.
questions.answer: Use time-aligned system and app slices to distinguish running, blocked and scheduled causes on the user critical path.
questions.explanation: This answer preserves the underlying platform or delivery contract while requiring representative evidence, explicit failure behaviour, and operational ownership.

questions.prompt: Instrumented method tracing is the least intrusive way to validate frame timing.
questions.explanation: Treating the total width of a trace slice as CPU time can misdiagnose a blocked wait as computation.

questions.prompt: Which trace evidence distinguishes computation from waiting?
questions.answer: Thread scheduling state, child work and system events aligned with the app slice.
questions.explanation: The response identifies the mechanism that makes the decision reliable instead of relying on a convenient proxy.
